instructions_for_CHAT: At the start of a new task, verify the projectwide GOVERNANCE Registry and this source-map on the owner-approved release branch, apply Governance EFFECTIVE source and independently check actual machine route support; NEVER treat product tests as a Governance document release requirement.
At task start resolve Owner-approved source applicable to that scope; never use highest filename or stale document header as operative current
Use this recorded Owner-operating resolution as a scoped human directive, not a cryptographically verified global machine Registry
Preserve old pinned Dispatches and forbid replay; no automatic full machine/Bridge adoption or test PASS invention
Use CODE-FIRST for independent offline app task preparation under real permissions; do not block it on Bridge worker installed READY

For INTERNAL_ONLY/NON_LIVE work, apply FOX2_INTERNAL_FAST_LANE_OWNER_OVERRIDE_20261022: Whole-WP first, compact R0-R7, reuse valid PASS, minimize standalone PreExec/PASS_TO_ASSIGN/evidence artifacts, and use one integrated internal validation where technically safe.

For bounded correction after CHAT_REWORK with unchanged Actor/Model/Thinking/permissions/allowed paths, reuse existing task/prompt/source authority and issue only a fresh no-replay Dispatch plus changed/time-dependent pre-consume checks; do not create a new Owner-facing micro-WP.

Independent WORK audit is not a default INTERNAL_ONLY gate; require it only for real financial safety, external provider/broker/LIVE, materially high-risk concurrency/recovery, contested authority, or explicit Owner request.

Current Bridge post-R5 internal path is R5_CHAT_ACCEPT -> BRIDGE_INTERNAL_VALIDATION -> FINAL_CHAT_ACCEPTANCE -> INTERNAL_FOX2_BRIDGE_READY; BRIDGE_INTERNAL_VALIDATION may combine A05, remaining G3/G4 assertions, local runtime trial and restart/no-replay.
Never apply Fast Lane to main/merge/deploy/provider/broker/LIVE or use it to convert FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN into PASS or replay a consumed Dispatch.
